hero.tagline: Security Monitoring • Alert Triage • Log Analysis • Web Application Security

paragraphs: I am a Cyber Security graduate with a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) from Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science, graduating with a CGPA of 9.21.
My cybersecurity interests include security operations, log analysis, threat detection, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and web application security.
During my Cyber Security Internship at Xyberu Pvt Ltd, I worked on security alert monitoring and triage, log analysis, IOC validation, vulnerability assessment, and security reporting.

I have also developed security-focused projects, including a machine-learning-based log anomaly detection pipeline and an automated Web VAPT reporting tool. My practical learning includes cybersecurity labs, CTF challenges, and continued development of defensive and offensive security skills.

projects.title: Real-Time ML-Based Log Anomaly Detection
projects.shortDescription: Developed a machine-learning-based log anomaly detection pipeline to process security-related log data, identify anomalous patterns, and visualize security insights through dashboards. The pipeline combines log ingestion and parsing, Python-based anomaly classification, PostgreSQL storage, and Grafana visualization.
features: Log ingestion and parsing using Logstash.
Python-based log processing, feature engineering, and anomaly classification.
Machine-learning approaches involving LightGBM and Isolation Forest, where implemented.
PostgreSQL storage for processed log records.
Grafana dashboards for visualizing anomalies and security insights.
Log analysis and anomaly detection to support security monitoring.

projects.title: Automated Web VAPT Reporting Tool
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack web platform to manage vulnerability assessments and auto-generate professional, audit-ready security reports with centralized vulnerability knowledge base.
features: Centralized vulnerability knowledge base with severity ratings
Custom tester observations without overwriting standard data
Auto-generated executive summaries and action plans
PDF and Docs export for audit-ready reports

highlights: Monitored real-time logs and security alerts to identify suspicious activity, unauthorized access attempts, and potential security threats.
Triage security alerts by analyzing event details, validating indicators of compromise (IOCs), and prioritizing findings according to severity and potential impact.
Analyzed log data to distinguish true positives from false positives, supporting more accurate investigations and appropriate incident escalation.
Performed vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (VAPT) on web applications to identify and validate security weaknesses.
Documented VAPT findings with risk ratings, supporting evidence, and recommended remediation steps for technical teams.
Immersed in Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows
Real-time threat monitoring and incident response
Gained expertise in log analysis and SIEM tools
